description: This Java test class, 'OpenmrsWebTestsTest', extends a base test class 'OpenmrsTestsTest' and is intended to run tests associated with the web layer of the OpenMRS project. It serves as a bridge to execute tests in the web module that might otherwise be skipped due to Maven's modular test execution separation.
